{{Quote|If this ship goes down, you'll go down with it&hellip;so row well and live.|[[Unidentified human (Roon)|Galley master]]|<ref name="AtRS">{{DroidsCite|Across the Roon Sea}}</ref>}}
The '''''Roon Clipper''''' was a ship in the [[Koong Navy|navy]] of [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Bisad Koong|Koong]] of [[Roon/Legends|Roon's]] [[Tawntoom]] province during the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The vessel was propelled by sails and the use of [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] rowers and carried at least two [[Drone fighter (Roon)|drone fighters]] in its [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]]. It also carried a number of lifeboats in case the crew needed to abandon ship.

==Description==
The ''Roon Clipper'' had a largely flat deck, with a structure located fore on the deck and a tower located aft. The vessel had two masts, extending from the fore structure and directly behind the rear tower, on which the sails were mounted. These sails had to be manually secured and released by climbing up the masts and the forward mast had a lookout post to provide a clear view ahead of the ship. The ship's propulsion was augmented by [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]], who were forced to row using the oars extending from the sides of the ship into the [[Water/Legends|water]]. However, the vessel was capable of movement without either the sails or the rowers. The ship was steered using a wheel located on top of the rear tower.<ref name="AtRS" />

A ramp led down from the deck to the slave quarters. Several rows of benches were located on either side of a central walkway, each with an oar and chains to prevent the escape of the slaves. There were typically two slaves on each row and the ship could carry at least twenty. Two rows of columns along the central walkway supported the deck above. A hatch from the deck led to the cargo hold, which could also be accessed through a door from the slave quarters.<ref name="AtRS" />

[[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Bisad Koong|Koong's]] cabin was located in one of the above-deck structures and contained a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] console and a large screen, which could be used for communications. When docked, a gangplank from the deck allowed the crew to board or disembark the ship. A hose was available to extinguish any fires on the ship.<ref name="AtRS" />

The ship had a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] located below the deck at the front of the vessel. The hangar could hold at least two [[Drone fighter (Roon)|drone fighters]]. A control panel on the deck had a lever to open and close the hangar door, and a button to trigger the [[Droid/Legends|droid]]-controlled [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to launch.<ref name="AtRS" />

Two lifeboats were attached to the rear of the vessel on either side. These smaller boats had a motor, as well as a single sail for propulsion. A swivel-mounted [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] at the rear of the lifeboats allowed them to target any enemies that might approach.<ref name="AtRS" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Star_Wars_Droids_Original_Production_KOONGS_VESSEL_Copy_Model_Design_BV853.png|thumb|left|200px|Concept art of the Roon Clipper]]
The ''Roon Clipper'' first appeared in "[[Across the Roon Sea]]," an episode of the animated series [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Star Wars Droids'']] written by [[Sharman DiVono]]. In the episode, the vessel was referred to only as Koong's galley. It was later named in Koong's entry in the [[Databank (original)|original Databank]] on [[StarWars.com]].
